title: Video by foodflixby_azizi
description:
Found a little Turkish escape in Mumbai 🇹🇷✨ 

Comment for location🇹🇷🥂

A beautiful spot with such an elegant ambience perfect for a relaxed meal with family or friends 🤎

We tried their Chelo Rice with Seekh & Tikka, comforting Mutton Shorba and ended on a sweet note with their creamy Tiramisu ☕️✨ Everything was packed with flavour!

And mutton lovers, you’re going to love this one they have so many mutton options to choose from! 🤤

Good food, beautiful vibes & such a wholesome dining experience 🤎✨

Timings:
Mon–Fri: 12 PM–3 PM | 7 PM–1:30 AM
Sat–Sun: 12 PM–3 PM | 7 PM–3 AM
